name: imagination
quote: She drew a horse with feathers.
description: Ability to create a mental object that was not previously experienced.
perceptions: I want to have a mental experience that meets certain criteria.

guidance.description: How to Expand Your Imagination in 8 Days

commentaries.quote: Imagination is sometimes thought of as a fun kid thing, but it's a critical part of many careers. For example, creativity in engineering and design drives those markets.
We must enjoy experiencing imagined things because we do it a lot.

Imagination may feel instantaneous but it's not. Here's how it works: (1) desire to mentally experience something that solves certain constraints. (2) let your subconscious focus on those constraints. It will come up with something. (3) Consider the results and refine the constraints as needed. For example, draw a creature that will make my kid smile. She likes dogs. A flying dog could be fun. But she also likes frogs, and a flying frog would be even sillier.

4,3.description: A desire to create a mental experience with certain constraints.
